notes: qam16 soft bits of 4096 symbols, 4 per symbol in output order (the components in memory order, re then im); the scale is the float32 of 5.3 (scale_bits); the first 12 components are 0, -0, the levels, the soft-bit boundaries +-k / sqrt(E) for even k, +-3 and +-1e-30, the rest random levels plus uniform noise in [-0.2, 0.2); snr_db_guard compares with the float64 definition with the exact sqrt(E) (D111), snr_db_optimum is that definition rounded once to float32
